commands.body: Existing owner refresh-token transport rules, no new token channel
Empty; id is the existing target refresh-row UUID, not a family alias

headers.X-Request-ID: Original caller-supplied UUID, not a server-generated correlation fallback

scope: Fresh active authenticated actor, valid stable family, exact operation/target/body/request identity; confirmed MFA must pre-exist the original command

persistence.intent: p11_security_commands PENDING committed before the owner effect transaction
persistence.terminal: Canonical effects/audit and SUCCEEDED receipt commit together
persistence.rejection: Known owner 4xx after verified rollback may persist REJECTED; DB/commit uncertainty remains PENDING shown as UNKNOWN
persistence.credentials: No password, password hash, MFA code, MFA secret, access token or refresh token stored in command/result/assurance. Body/credential/factor bindings are keyed HMAC digests only.
persistence.result: PII-free owner facts only, with exact persisted password time/family revocation, never reconstructed from current lookup as an old result

responses.unknown_reason: 503 avoids treating 202 as session-ending success in browser cookie middleware
responses.missing: UNKNOWN, request_state=NOT_FOUND, CHECK_ONLY, support_resolution_required=true; no negative execution proof
responses.null_policy: Unknown completion/result fields are absent, state is explicit; no null/fake result/time
responses.retry_policy: CHECK_ONLY; no blind command replay/new key/body/version/session takeover
responses.terminal_same_key: May return a verified terminal receipt without executing effects again; command_replayed=false
responses.pending_key_rotation: Any unresolved security intent blocks new native security intent for that actor
responses.legacy_downgrade: Removing the header cannot bypass PENDING. A family that adopted native receipts must keep the native protocol, even after rejection.
responses.session_policy: Logout preserves drafts/shifts. Password change revokes all families. Current-family DELETE remains protected. No token/body allowlist expansion.

read.same_family: Current valid original family may read
read.new_family: Explicit additional verification required; never automatic

verification.mfa_owner: Existing MfaService TOTP or one-use recovery code, serialized on MFA row with atomic TOTP replay marker
verification.assurance_store: p11_security_reconciliations, no bearer credential or password
verification.failure_audit: Password/MFA denial and successful verification are audited without credentials

time: UTC explicit-offset writes/read casts for MFA security instants; no repair/backfill of historical timestamps
release_requirements: Review proof/receipt retention and support resolution
Apply reviewed additive schema before enabling
Do not disable the protocol while adopted families/PENDING intents still need reconciliation
Authenticated DEV smoke and App owner/journal acceptance
old_unknown_without_identity: Audited support resolution required, not auto-adopted/backfilled/replayed by a new family
